note: Whole-body IEM protocol v0.4: the v0.3 protocol on Harvetta 1.03d, biomarker minima on Harvey and Harvetta, and a MATLAB runIEM_HH reference on Harvetta (docs/studies/wbm-iem-v0.4-plan.md). Not an independent evaluation: the IEM ground truth, the Harvey v0.3 results and the published Harvetta accuracy are known. The freeze fixes the runs, the scoring and the reading rules before any Harvetta IEM result or any biomarker minimum exists. The organism fields are required by the freeze schema and do not apply to this study.

runs.B_harvey_minima: python3 scripts/run_wbm_iem.py Harvey_1_03d --model-setup toolbox --bile-duct toolbox --senses min --out-suffix _v0.4_min
runs.C_harvetta_minima: python3 scripts/run_wbm_iem.py Harvetta_1_03d --model-setup toolbox --bile-duct toolbox --senses min --out-suffix _v0.4_min

shards: Runs B and C may be split into disjoint --iems shards with suffixes _v0.4_min_a and _v0.4_min_b, merged only under one run fingerprint.
primary: Q1 on Harvetta: A1 accuracy and coverage; A2 Python vs MATLAB (bounds, calls, non-finite MATLAB optima, runIEM_HH formula); A3 equal positive maxima among no-change errors; A4 correct calls by relative threshold tau in {0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10}
secondary: Q2 on both models: range rules R1 (full range) and R2 (tie-break) from scripts/iem_range_calls.py against the maximum-only protocol on directional biomarkers with four optimal finite optima

reading_rules.Q1: (a) identical setup bounds; (b) identical calls wherever both MATLAB optima are finite; (c) at least one non-finite MATLAB optimum for a directional biomarker and runIEM_HH formula below Python accuracy among scored; (d) more than half of no-change errors have equal positive maxima; (e) descriptive count of correct calls below tau = 0.05
reading_rules.Q2_R1: supported if R1 has more correct calls than max-only on both models; harmful if fewer on either; inconclusive otherwise
reading_rules.Q2_R2: useful if on both models R2 turns more max-only errors into correct calls than into opposite-direction calls
